_note: Photography and menu links, keyed by slug. An entry exists ONLY when the pairing between the image and this exact outlet was established from a source that names the outlet — an operator locations page whose card carries both the address and the photo, or a Places record matched on name and address. An empty images array is the normal, honest state: it renders a drawn plate, never a stock photo standing in for a cafe nobody has photographed.
_imageFields: images[] = {url | photoName, alt, caption?, credit?, creditUrl?, source, sourceUrl, verified, license?, dateChecked, confidence, width?, height?}. source is one of official-website | official-instagram | wikimedia-commons | google-places | other-verified. verified is one sentence saying how the outlet identity was established. width lets srcset stop short of an upscale. Google Places photos are stored as photoName and served through /api/place-photo — Places media URLs are short-lived redirects and must never be persisted as if they were assets.
